descriptionHtml:
The Annual General Meeting of the IEEE RAS Student Branch Chapter University of Peradeniya was held on 24th February 2020 at the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering seminar room Thereby the former members concluded their duties and handed over to the new office bearers marking the inaugaration of the term 2020.
The new office bearers were elected and selected for the year 2019. Mr. Madusha Athapattu was selected as the new chairperson, Mr Primash Morapitiya was selected as the new vice chair and Mr. Asith Devinda as the secretary of the society. The meeting concluded with the hope of continuing a successful year ahead.
